[[Dehvit Notigunahm]] can be found staring into the hills southwest of the plaza.

==Locations==
*[[Vabbi]]
** {{NPC location|Forum Highlands}} (on the highest platform surrounding the [[Font of Lyss]])

==Dialogue==
:''"[[Vabbi]] is the wealthiest spot in the world. [[Lion's Arch]] can't touch us for beauty. [[Kryta]] could never match our trade. And, despite its size, you'll never see [[Elonian]] quality workmanship in [[Kaineng City]]."''

==Quotes==
:''"Show me a traveled adventurer and I'll show you a wise soul...you can't truly understand the world unless you've seen it."''
:''"[[Vabbi]] can endure anything. We survived [[Palawa Joko]]. We'll survive this."''

==Trivia==
*The name sounds very similar to "David Nottingham", but it is not known who was the inspiration for this name.
